records.prompt:
Create a corrected BACK-VIEW WALK CYCLE for Leon, the brown-haired boy with blue tunic, silver shoulder armor and red cape. The reference is the exact existing character style, clothing and BACK design. The old walking frames are WRONG: the same leg stays forward. Replace that with OBVIOUSLY ALTERNATING LEFT AND RIGHT LEGS. Only six full-body rear-view walkers, facing directly away from viewer/up-screen. Transparent RGBA, 1536x1024. EXACT grid THREE COLUMNS by TWO ROWS, six 512x512 cells, 48px transparent margins. All heads same size, centered horizontally, same silhouette, outfit and lighting, clean bold dark-brown pixel-painted outline. Keep the asymmetric red cape on the same side in every frame. Do NOT flip the whole figure to fake walking.
TOP ROW is the LEFT-FOOT step, BOTTOM ROW is the RIGHT-FOOT step. These rows must have OPPOSITE leg poses while head and torso stay identical.
Frame 1 top left: viewer LEFT boot planted, visibly extends LOWER on screen; viewer RIGHT boot lifted behind, its sole visible and higher.
Frame 2 top middle: weight on LEFT boot, RIGHT knee bent and foot passing beside the LEFT calf, right sole visible.
Frame 3 top right: RIGHT foot swings forward (up-screen), LEFT heel begins to lift. Legs clearly separated.
Frame 4 bottom left: REVERSE frame1 legs ONLY: viewer RIGHT boot planted, visibly extends LOWER on screen; viewer LEFT boot lifted behind, its sole visible and higher.
Frame 5 bottom middle: weight on RIGHT boot, LEFT knee bent and foot passing beside RIGHT calf, left sole visible.
Frame 6 bottom right: LEFT foot swings forward (up-screen), RIGHT heel begins to lift. Legs clearly separated.
Small natural walking strides with opposing arm swing. The FOOT reaching the bottom of its cell must alternate LEFT in frames1-3, RIGHT in frames4-6. Do not draw every frame with the same lower boot. No furniture, cup, tool, labels, numbers, background, floor, shadow or extra figures. Exactly SIX sprites.

The BOTTOM LEFT cell already has the correct right-foot-planted pose: use that leg arrangement as the reference for the other two bottom cells, with small passing/swing differences. TOP ROW remains unchanged. Preserve all heads, torsos, arms, clothes, cape asymmetry, frame positions, size, style and alpha exactly. Bottom row must NOT repeat the top row leg arrangement. No background, shadows or additional elements. 1536x1024 RGBA transparent. This is a necessary left-right gait correction, not a whole image mirror.
